name: Tuan Leng Tay
title: Assistant Professor, Microglia, Alzheimer’s Disease
research: How does our brain develop, respond to damage or foreign bodies, and repair itself? The Tay Lab seeks to understand the processes and mechanisms underlying these changes across the lifespan by studying microglia, the principle immune cells in the central nervous system.
